releases.notes:
The first release of Bloodmoon Events for **Fabric, Minecraft 1.21.1**. Requires Fabric API and Java 21.

It has the same features, config and commands as [1.0.1 for 26.3](https://github.com/Lucalaure/BloodmoonEvents/releases/tag/v1.0.1), and the same config file works on both.

Every 7th night a **Blood Moon** rises. The sky, fog, clouds and light turn red, the moon swells and turns crimson, and nobody can sleep. Until dawn, a horde of mobs with upgraded AI besieges every player.

### The Blood Moon
- Starts on night 7, then every 7th night after. You can change the interval and add a random chance for other nights.
- You get a warning at sunset, a **"Blood Moon #N"** title and raid horn when it starts, and a message at dawn.
- The red sky fades in and out over 5 seconds. The moon is red, larger and always full. Beds don't let you sleep, but still set your spawn point.

### The horde
- Waves spawn 24–44 blocks around each survival player, and in caves too if the player is underground.
- Horde mobs track players through walls. At dawn they drop anything they picked up (such as your gear after you died) and vanish. Those items get a 10-minute despawn timer instead of 5.
- **Zombies** (and husks, zombie villagers, drowned) build their way to you:
  - pillar up to players above them.
  - climb over walls.
  - build steps.
  - bridge gaps.
  - from Blood Moon #3 they also break through walls, doors and ceilings. Harder blocks take longer, and several zombies on one block break it faster.
- **Creepers** that can't reach you light their fuse once they're within 8 blocks.
- **Slimes and magma cubes** jump much higher and lunge at you.
- Respects the `mob_griefing` gamerule. Chests and other containers, and obsidian-tier blocks, are never broken.

### Difficulty grows with every Blood Moon
Mob health, damage and speed never scale; the horde's size, roster, armour and abilities do. Values grow from #1 to #10, then stay there.

| | #1 | #5 | #10+ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Max horde per player | 12 | 29 | 50 |
| Mobs per wave | 2 | 4 | 6 |
| Time between waves | 8 s | 6 s | 4 s |
| Chance of extra armour (never drops) | 0% | 27% | 60% |

**What unlocks when:**
- **#1:** zombies, skeletons and spiders. Zombies place blocks.
- **#3:** creepers, husks, zombie villagers and slimes join. Zombies break blocks and creepers blast through walls.
- **#4:** slime super jump.
- **#5:** witches and cave spiders join. The horde tracks you from 64 blocks instead of 40.

### RPG Advanced Difficulty compatibility (optional)
With [RPG Advanced Difficulty](https://github.com/Lucalaure/rpgAdvancedDifficulty) installed, horde mobs are more likely to be champions, from ×1.5 on #1 to ×4 on #10, and later Blood Moons make higher tiers proportionally more common. Neither mod requires the other.

### Commands
- `/bloodmoon` (anyone): shows the next Blood Moon's number and how many nights until it rises.
- `/bloodmoon start | stop | level <n> | reload` (operators).

### Config
`config/bloodmoonevents.json`: the schedule, horde roster and weights, every scaling start/end value, unlock levels and AI toggles.

### Differences from the 26.3 version
- The full moon during a Blood Moon is visual only. On 26.3 the server also treats the night as a full moon, which slightly raises local difficulty and swamp slime spawns. On 1.21.1 those follow the real moon phase.

releases.notes:
A bug-fix update for **Fabric, Minecraft 26.3**.

### Fixes
- **Horde mobs no longer delete your items at dawn.** Horde mobs still vanish at sunrise, so you can't be spawn-camped after the Blood Moon ends. But first they drop everything they picked up, such as your gear after you died, right where they stand. Those items get a 10-minute despawn timer instead of 5, so you have time to get back to them after respawning.
- **The armour the horde spawns with still never drops**, so a Blood Moon can't be farmed for iron.
- **Horde mobs in chunks that weren't loaded at dawn** are handled the same way when the chunk loads again. Before, they were deleted along with anything they carried.
- **With `despawnAtDawn` set to `false`**, surviving horde mobs now become ordinary mobs that can despawn naturally. Before, they stayed in the world forever. Mobs holding picked-up items stay, same as vanilla.

### Other
- New mod icon.
